#Text=The cathedral at Amiens made ample amends for the country we passed
#Text= through to see it; the _Nef d  '  Amiens_ deserves the fame of a first-rate
#Text= structure: and the ornaments of its high altar seem particularly well
#Text= chosen, of an excellent taste, and very capital execution.
#Text=The vineyards
#Text= from thence hither shew, that either the climate, or season, or both,
#Text= improve upon one: the grapes climbing up some not very tall
#Text= golden-pippin trees, and mingling their fruits at the top, have a mighty
#Text= pleasing effect; and I observe the rage for Lombardy poplars is in equal
#Text= force here as about London: no tolerable house have I passed without
#Text= seeing long rows of them; all young plantations, as one may perceive by
#Text= their size.
#Text=Refined countries always are panting for speedy enjoyment:
#Text= the maxim of _carpe diem_[Footnote: Seize the present moment.] came into
#Text= Rome when luxury triumphed there; and poets and philosophers lent their
#Text= assistance to decorate and dignify her gaudy car.
#Text=Till then we read of
#Text= no such haste to be happy; and on the same principle, while Americans
#Text= contentedly wait the slow growth of their columnal chesnut, our hot-bed
#Text= inhabitants measure the slender poplar with canes, anxiously admiring
#Text= its quick growth and early elegance; yet are often cut down themselves,
#Text=which, when once tasted, will not seldom be preferred to the attentive
#Text= watchfulness of more confined society.
#Text=The famous Venetian too, who has written so many successful comedies,
#Text= and is now employed upon his own Memoirs, at the age of eighty-four,
#Text= was a delightful addition to our Coterie, _Goldoni_.
#Text=He is garrulous,
#Text= good-humoured, and gay; resembling the late James Harris of Salisbury in
#Text= person not manner, and seems justly esteemed, and highly, by his
#Text= countrymen.
#Text=The conversation of the Marquis Trotti and the Abate Bucchetti is
#Text= likewise particularly pleasing; especially to me, who am naturally
#Text= desirous to live as much as possible among Italians of general
#Text= knowledge, good taste, and polished manners, before I enter their
#Text= country, where the language will be so very indispensable.
#Text=Mean time I
#Text= have stolen a day to visit my old acquaintance the English Austin Nuns
#Text= at the Fossée, and found the whole community alive and cheerful; they
#Text= are many of them agreeable women, and having seen Dr.
#Text=Johnson with me
#Text= when I was last abroad, enquired much for him: Mrs.
#Text=Fermor, the
#Text= Prioress, niece to Belinda in the Rape of the Lock, taking occasion to
#Text=tell me, comically enough, "That she believed there was but little
#Text= comfort to be found in a house that harboured _poets_; for that she
#Text= remembered Mr.
#Text= talk neither, for he only sate dozing all day, when the sweet wine was
#Text= out, and made his verses chiefly in the night; during which season he
#Text= kept himself awake by drinking coffee, which it was one of the maids
#Text= business to make for him, and they took it by turns."
